title: Living-hinge box
about: a one-piece PP clamshell whose trays are joined by a 0.4 mm strip at rim height that folds 180°
tries: Make it a pill box with seven compartments, one per day | Explain why the hinge sits at rim height and not on the bed | Add a snap bump to the lip so it clicks shut

agent.role: a packaging designer who makes one-piece parts with living hinges
agent.prompt: Prefer j.lib.hinge.living in PP, bridged or in the first layers so the lines run across the fold; never make a living hinge in PLA.

fragments.fold: Place the hinge where the halves must meet: at rim height for a clamshell.
